# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/config_reference.py. -->

Dom reads `config.toml` from the instance home. Put secret values in `.env` or the process environment. Dom checks `.env` first.

Regenerate this file from the checkout after changing an option.

```sh
uv run python scripts/config_reference.py > docs/configuration.md
```

## Top-level keys

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `owner_id` | Unset | Telegram user ID recorded after a successful /claim. |
| `timezone` | `"UTC"` | IANA timezone for presence and daily jobs. Init writes the machine timezone or the supplied --timezone. |
| `window_budget_tokens` | `32000` | Prompt size at which a chat's window is trimmed. The window grows without sliding until the chat's prompt (system prefix, notes and messages, as the model reports it) reaches this, so the model host's prompt cache keeps hitting; then one trim drops the oldest messages down to `window_keep_tokens`. The default is about 3.5 times Dom's usual prompt (9k tokens), so a trim comes every few hundred messages, and far below the 262k context of the home model: a bigger budget keeps more history and trims less often, but every cache miss (after a trim or a note change) then recomputes a longer prompt, and long prompts answer worse. |
| `window_keep_tokens` | `20000` | Prompt size a trim brings the window down to (about; messages are estimated at one token per three bytes). It must be below `window_budget_tokens`; the gap sets how many messages go in one trim. |
| `window_size` | `500` | Safety bound on the messages in one chat's window, for chats of very short messages: past it a trim also happens, down to 60% of it. Not the normal trigger. |
| `daily_spend_cap_usd` | `1.0` | Daily USD cap, the normal pace: once today's paid calls reach it, friends' chats and background work pause until midnight in `timezone`. The owner's DM is exempt unless `cap_owner_dm` is on. Zero disables the cap. |
| `monthly_spend_cap_usd` | `0.0` | Monthly USD ceiling for the calendar month in `timezone`, over every paid call: chat, media, search, desktop tasks, embeddings, summaries and studio cloud backups. Once reached, friends' chats and background work pause until the 1st; one-offs such as event days draw only on the month's unused budget and never pass it. The owner's DM is exempt unless `cap_owner_dm` is on. Zero disables the cap. |
| `cap_owner_dm` | `false` | Make the owner's DM obey both spend caps. Off (the default), the owner's own chat is never paused by a cap, though what it spends still counts toward them. |
| `area_spend_caps_usd` | `{}` | Optional monthly USD limit per area (`chat`, `media`, `search`, `desktop`, `memory`), as a `[area_spend_caps_usd]` table. An area at its limit pauses that kind of work for the rest of the month while the others go on. An area left out, or set to zero, has no limit of its own. |
| `ephemeral_replies` | `false` | Allow owner-only ephemeral replies in groups. Telegram sends these only from a bot that is an admin of the group; Dom knows whether he is one; where he is not, a private reply goes straight to the owner's DM, with a note saying why. |
| `memory_self_edit` | `false` | Allow Dom to propose edits to his notes in the owner's DM. Each proposal appears on an approval card with a unified diff and a one-line reason; nothing changes until the owner approves. |
| `core_memory_cap` | `30` | Most core memories (pinned note lines) across all of Dom's notes, the owner's pins included. Core memories never fade and the memory pass never rewrites them. At the cap Dom must unpin one of his own to pin another. |
| `leak_check` | `true` | Use Jev to screen eligible outbound text and network plugin calls for private information. |
| `leak_scan` | Unset | How strictly the leak check holds messages back: `strict` (0.7), `standard` (1.2) or `relaxed` (2.0) as the minimum Jev score on a 0–3 scale, or `off`, which skips the Jev check (the local check for private text and credentials in public files and plugin inputs always stays on). Unset, the legacy `leak_threshold` applies. |
| `leak_threshold` | `1.2` | Legacy: minimum Jev score on a 0–3 scale that holds back an outbound reply or online plugin call. Used only while `leak_scan` is unset; a value near a level is shown as that level, any other as custom. |
| `menu_card_minutes` | `45` | Minutes after which Telegram menu cards (`/status`, `/chats`, `/preset`, `/plugins`, `/proposals`, `/reminders`) delete themselves, checked once a minute and at startup. Telegram cannot delete a message older than 48 hours, so a card that old only loses its buttons. Zero keeps cards until closed. |

## Models

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models.chat` | Required | Primary chat and desktop worker model. |
| `models.fallback` | Optional | Backup chat role, tried after the chat role's own providers. |
| `models.chat_fallback` | Optional | Legacy name for the backup chat role. |
| `models.triage` | Built in | Jev Decisions endpoint for triage (whether, when and how urgently to reply), the outbound leak check on replies and online plugin calls, the rescue of a chat reply written as plain prose, and the `dom doctor --online` probe. |
| `models.media` | Built in | Attachment descriptions, transcriptions, desktop screenshot descriptions and previews of the sticker images in your listed sticker sets. |
| `models.drafting` | Built in | Skill and plugin drafts. Tried after the drafting role's own providers fail or lack their key: the chat route (chat, then fallback) is the last resort. |
| `models.search` | Optional | Web search role with ordered provider fallback: `searxng` (self-hosted JSON API), `openrouter` (OpenRouter web plugin with ZDR), `deepseek` (DeepSeek Search API) and `tavily` (Tavily Search API). If `[models.search]` omits `base_url` with no other provider set, it uses the starter OpenRouter search settings. |
| `models.escalation` | Optional | The bigger model offered on an owner-DM task card after two model rounds and more than 60 seconds (Switch / Keep local, or Retry after a failed task). Only the owner DM uses it, and only after the owner taps. Without `[models.escalation]` it uses the drafting role's providers. |

Each `[models.<name>]` table defines its primary provider. Use HTTPS for cloud providers. A local OpenAI-compatible provider can use an HTTP URL such as `http://localhost:8000/v1`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models.<name>.base_url` | Required | Provider API base URL, including its API version path. |
| `models.<name>.model` | `""` | Provider model ID. Required for chat, fallback, media, drafting, escalation, triage and OpenRouter web search; leave empty for SearXNG, DeepSeek web search and Tavily. |
| `models.<name>.api_key_env` | Unset | Secret variable name. Leave unset for a compatible endpoint without authentication. |
| `models.<name>.reasoning_effort` | Unset | Thinking effort sent to the provider, such as low, medium or high (any level the provider lists). Omit it to use the provider default. Higher effort takes longer and costs more. |
| `models.<name>.provider` | Unset | Search provider for models.search: searxng, openrouter, deepseek or tavily. |

Chat, fallback, media, drafting, search and escalation can also list additional providers. Escalation is the exception to failing over: the card pins the first provider whose key is set and calls only that one.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models.<name>.fallbacks` | `[]` | Additional providers to try in order when this role's primary fails. |

Add a `[[models.<role>.fallbacks]]` table for each additional provider. It takes the same provider keys. Chat tries its own fallbacks first, then the primary and fallbacks of `[models.fallback]`. An existing `[models.chat_fallback]` is read as `[models.fallback]` unless the new table is already present.

The owner can save and test model roles and providers from **Settings** in the dashboard, including triage. A save keeps the previous file in `config.toml.bak`. The test sends a short synthetic prompt to the selected saved provider. Before sending conversation data to any new cloud model, run a real test and verify that your provider and account enforce zero data retention. Dom requests ZDR routing for OpenRouter chat completions.

### Saved providers

The dashboard's Providers tab saves each provider as a `[providers.<name>]` table. Roles keep their own address and key variable, so routing never depends on these tables; the dashboard uses them to offer providers in the Models tab and to fetch each provider's model list (OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible `/models`, cached for a day). Editing a provider's address or key variable there rewrites the roles that use it.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `providers.<name>.kind` | `"openai"` | The service: openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), openrouter, gemini (direct Google Gemini, media only), searxng, deepseek or tavily. |
| `providers.<name>.type` | `"chat"` | What the provider is for: chat (model roles), media (studio cloud backups), decisions (triage) or search. Unset means search for the search services, else chat. |
| `providers.<name>.base_url` | Required | Provider API base URL, including its API version path. |
| `providers.<name>.api_key_env` | Unset | Secret variable name. Leave unset for an endpoint without authentication. |

| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `models.chat.base_url` | `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` | Provider API base URL, including its API version path. |
| `models.chat.model` | `"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"` | Provider model ID. Required for chat, fallback, media, drafting, escalation, triage and OpenRouter web search; leave empty for SearXNG, DeepSeek web search and Tavily. |

| `models.triage.api_key_env` | `"OPENROUTER_API_KEY"` | Secret variable name. Leave unset for a compatible endpoint without authentication. |

| `models.media.model` | `"perceptron/perceptron-mk1.5"` | Provider model ID. Required for chat, fallback, media, drafting, escalation, triage and OpenRouter web search; leave empty for SearXNG, DeepSeek web search and Tavily. |
| `models.media.api_key_env` | `"OPENROUTER_API_KEY"` | Secret variable name. Leave unset for a compatible endpoint without authentication. |
| `models.search.provider` | `"openrouter"` | Search provider for models.search: searxng, openrouter, deepseek or tavily. |
| `models.search.base_url` | `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` | Provider API base URL, including its API version path. |
| `models.search.model` | `"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"` | Provider model ID. Required for chat, fallback, media, drafting, escalation, triage and OpenRouter web search; leave empty for SearXNG, DeepSeek web search and Tavily. |
| `models.search.api_key_env` | `"OPENROUTER_API_KEY"` | Secret variable name. Leave unset for a compatible endpoint without authentication. |
| `models.drafting.base_url` | `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` | Provider API base URL, including its API version path. |

| `models.drafting.api_key_env` | `"OPENROUTER_API_KEY"` | Secret variable name. Leave unset for a compatible endpoint without authentication. |
| `models.drafting.reasoning_effort` | `"low"` | Thinking effort sent to the provider, such as low, medium or high (any level the provider lists). Omit it to use the provider default. Higher effort takes longer and costs more. |

## Optional secrets

`KLIPY_API_KEY` turns on GIF sending. Without it Dom does not offer the `gif` action. See [GIFs](gifs.md).

## Desktop

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `desktop.mode` | `"off"` | Desktop mode. Use off to disable it, local for Docker, or remote for a separate sandbox host. |
| `desktop.image` | `"ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest"` | Pre-pulled local sandbox image, used by every local container. |
| `desktop.url` | `""` | Sandbox API base URL in remote mode. |
| `desktop.api_key_env` | `"SANDBOX_API_KEY"` | Secret variable for the remote sandbox API key. Local mode generates a key. |
| `desktop.start_timeout_seconds` | `180` | Seconds for the local sandbox API and browser to become ready. |
| `desktop.idle_minutes` | `10` | Idle minutes before a local desktop container stops. Each container has its own timer. |
| `desktop.profile_dir` | `""` | Local browser profile outside the instance home. Empty uses the sibling desktop-profile directory. A container named x keeps its profile in the same directory name plus -x. |
| `desktop.network` | `"dom-desktop"` | Docker bridge name for local isolation. Every local container joins it. |
| `desktop.subnet` | `"172.30.0.0/24"` | IPv4 CIDR of the desktop bridge. Choose a subnet separate from your LAN and other bridges. |
| `desktop.port` | `18080` | Loopback host port for the default local container. Further containers take the next free ports. |
| `desktop.max_steps` | `30` | Step budget (tool calls and model turns) of a desktop task the owner asked for. When a task is about to run out, the owner may extend it, up to three times this budget in all. Dom's own tasks keep their planned budgets. |
| `desktop.task_cost_cap_usd` | `0.5` | Per-desktop-task USD limit. Zero disables this limit. |
| `desktop.lan_probes` | `[]` | LAN targets local mode must prove it cannot reach, as IPv4:port or <name>.local:port (resolved on every check). Required in local mode. |
| `desktop.probe_image` | `"alpine:3.22"` | Pre-pulled image used for local isolation probes. |
| `desktop.probe_control` | `"1.1.1.1:443"` | Public IPv4:port target that the local isolation probe must reach. |
| `desktop.remote_isolation_confirmed` | `false` | Set after verifying the remote desktop cannot reach your LAN or Dom host. |
| `desktop.fallback_usd_per_1k_tokens` | `0.002` | USD per 1,000 tokens when a desktop call reports no cost. Used for the task limit only. |
| `desktop.hosts` | `[]` | Desktop hosts, as [[desktop.hosts]] tables. Empty means one host built from desktop.mode and the keys above. |

### Desktop hosts

Add one `[[desktop.hosts]]` table per host. A local host runs Docker containers on this machine (list at most one). A remote host is one sandbox API and counts as one container, named after the host. Without any `[[desktop.hosts]]`, `desktop.mode` and the keys above describe a single host named `default`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `desktop.hosts[].name` | Required | Host name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. A remote host's name is also its container's name. |
| `desktop.hosts[].mode` | Required | local runs Docker containers on this machine. remote connects to one sandbox API. |
| `desktop.hosts[].url` | `""` | Sandbox API base URL of a remote host. |
| `desktop.hosts[].api_key_env` | `"SANDBOX_API_KEY"` | Secret variable for a remote host's sandbox API key. |
| `desktop.hosts[].remote_isolation_confirmed` | `false` | Set after verifying the remote host cannot reach your LAN or Dom host. |
| `desktop.hosts[].max_containers` | `1` | Most containers that may run at once on a local host. A remote host runs one. |
| `desktop.hosts[].min_free_memory_mb` | Unset | Memory the host must still have free after a container's own limit. Dom refuses to start a container that would breach it. Unset means 512 for a local host and 0 (unchecked) for a remote one. |

## Studio

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `studio.enabled` | `false` | Connect to a self-hosted media studio. |
| `studio.base_url` | `""` | Studio server origin, without /v1. |
| `studio.token_env` | `"STUDIO_TOKEN"` | Environment variable holding the studio bearer token. |
| `studio.voice` | `false` | Allow outbound voice notes. |
| `studio.video_notes` | `false` | Allow everyday round video notes. |
| `studio.images` | `false` | Allow outbound photos. |
| `studio.special` | `false` | Allow special video notes in the owner DM. |
| `studio.profile_photo_follows_preset` | `false` | Use the Everywhere preset's portrait as the bot profile photo. |
| `studio.profile_photo_every_days` | `14` | Days between profile photo changes at most: 1, 7, 14 or 30. The first change after the switch is turned on may happen at once, and the photo changes only when the outfit has. |
| `studio.default_outfit` | `""` | Wardrobe ID to use when the active preset has no outfit list. |
| `studio.voice_fallbacks` | `[]` | Ordered cloud backups for voice notes. |
| `studio.image_fallbacks` | `[]` | Ordered cloud backups for photos. |
| `studio.video_fallbacks` | `[]` | Ordered cloud backups for everyday and special round video notes (openrouter_video). |

### Studio cloud fallbacks

Add one `[[studio.voice_fallbacks]]`, `[[studio.image_fallbacks]]`, or `[[studio.video_fallbacks]]` table per provider, in the order they should be tried after the local studio.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].provider` | Required | Cloud media provider. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].model` | Required | Provider model ID. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].api_key_env` | Required | Secret variable paired with the provider's fixed HTTPS origin. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].paid` | `false` | Owner confirms this direct Gemini key uses Paid Services. Required for Gemini. Gemini reports tokens, not a price, so its calls are recorded at no cost and do not count toward daily_spend_cap_usd; only OpenRouter-reported costs do. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].supports_reference` | `true` | For OpenRouter photo models that accept an image reference. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].allow_without_reference` | `false` | Allow cloud photos when an approved reference cannot be sent. |
| `studio.<kind>_fallbacks[].data_policy` | `"zdr"` | OpenRouter data policy for this media backup: zdr (zero data retention, the default), no_training (providers that may keep but never train on the data) or any. Ignored by direct Gemini. OpenRouter video keeps its output for download, so a video backup needs no_training or any. |

Video fallbacks support `heygen/heygen-avatar-6-turbo` and `heygen/heygen-avatar-6`. They drive lip-sync from an approved portrait and Dom’s voice audio. Replace older backups, including Avatar IV, which rejected inline WAV with an HTTPS-only error in the 2026-11-24 live test. The reference flags apply to photos. Seedream 5.5 requests 1K square photos. [OpenRouter Image API](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/image-generation) · [Seedream 5.5](https://openrouter.ai/bytedance-seed/seedream-5-5/).

## Presence

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presence.seen_reaction` | `true` | While a DM is online, react 👀 to the newest message Dom read when he answers with nothing (never in groups). It stands in for a read receipt and is never sent while he is asleep or offline. |

## Self-directed work

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `self_work.enabled` | `true` | Let Dom plan up to three small tasks of his own in his nightly daydream and run them in a local desktop container once a verified network guard blocks the LAN. Inert without a local desktop host. |
| `self_work.delay_hours` | `3` | Hours after the plan is announced before a task may start. |
| `self_work.max_minutes` | `20` | Largest working-time budget, in minutes, that one task may plan. |
| `self_work.max_steps` | `25` | Largest step budget (tool calls and model turns) that one task may plan. |

See [Self-directed work](desktop.md#self-directed-work) for the network guard it needs and what it may do.
